body: Agent decides "disk is not the hub release" by comparing the sha256 of the shim source file with the SHA256SUMS line of its asset, not by comparing build ids (alternative: hub sends its build in update and the agent runs `<disk exe> --version`); one small GET per press, exact for release binaries.

Three additive UpdateOutcome variants (download_failed, checksum_mismatch, no_release_build) with three static hub notices instead of one DownloadFailed plus a reason field (alternative: optional reason field on update_answer, touching every UpdateAnswer site); old hubs read them as Other -> UPDATE_FAILED_NOTICE.
No macOS codesign after the swap (alternative: `codesign -s -` as update_e2e does): the asset is written byte-identical, keeps the linker ad-hoc signature, and install.sh does not sign it either.
Download bounded to 90 s, not 120 s, so the answer lands inside the hub UPDATE_WAIT (120 s from the press); size cap 64 MiB binary, 64 KiB SHA256SUMS.
A failed download answers its failure and does not fall back to a plain reload of whatever is on disk (alternative: reload the disk file when it differs); the user presses again.

Verdict NEEDS_WORK, not SHIP: a tagged hub never falls back to the disk plan when fetch fails (Missing/Download), so the manual install the NO_RELEASE_BUILD/DOWNLOAD_FAILED notices recommend is never picked up; alternative considered: SHIP with a follow-up task, rejected because the loop is user-visible on unsupported platforms and offline machines from day one.
